senses.gloss: (√בד, v. בדד) to separate, divide, distinguish; (neut. v.) בָּדֵל to keep aloof.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 87b:4">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>בְּדוֹל עצמך וכ׳</he> withdraw thyself from (touching) her.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:5:2">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵇ</cite> top <he>כדי שיהא בָּדֵל מן התרומה</he> in order that he may be careful in handling T’rummah.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> it seems to me <he>שחברים בְּדֵילִים וכ׳</he> that the colleagues hold themselves aloof from thee (i.e. thou art excommunicated).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 89a">Ib. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ בתמרים</he> to separate (with a tool) dates which stick together (cmp. Rashi a. l.); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 2:4:4">Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ</cite> top <he>הבדיל בתמרים</he> (read <he>הבודל</he>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 5a:6">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>יסורין בְּדֵילִין וכ׳</he> pains will stay away from him; a. fr.

<cite ref="Chullin 21b:4">Ḥull. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מולק ואינו מַבְדִּיל</he> he nips the bird’s neck but must not sever a limb or cut with his nail deeper than required (<cite ref="Leviticus 1:17">Lev. I, 17</cite>). Ib. I, 7 <he>המבדיל בין וכ׳</he> He who established distinctions between (the) sanctity (of the Sabbath) and (the) sanctity (of the Festivals); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of אַבְדָּלָה or הַבְדָּלָה) to recite the benediction Hammabdil on the exit of the Sabbath or Festival, to say Habdalah. Ibid. כיצד מבדילין what formula must you use (at the exit of the Sabbath and the simultaneous beginning of a Festival)? a. fr.—Part. Hof. מוּבְדָּל separated, distinguished.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite> beg. <he>מוּבְדָּלִים וכ׳</he> are different from the doings of other nations.
<cite ref="Nazir 7a:9">Naz. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>מוּבְדָּלוֹת זו מזו</he> are separated one from another.
<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 3:5">Tosef. Peah III, 5</cite>; a. fr.
